record.bible_text: He that dwelleth<WH03427><WTH8802> in the secret<WH05643> place of the most High<WH05945> shall abide<WH03885><WTH8698> under the shadow<WH06738> of the Almighty<WH07706>. <RF>abide: Heb. lodge<Rf>
I will say<WH0559><WTH8799> of the LORD<WH03068>, <FI>He is<Fi> my refuge<WH04268> and my fortress<WH04686>: my God<WH0430>; in him will I trust<WH0982><WTH8799>.
Surely he shall deliver<WH05337><WTH8686> thee from the snare<WH06341> of the fowler<WH03353>, <FI>and<Fi> from the noisome<WH01942> pestilence<WH01698>.

He shall cover<WH05526><WTH8686> thee with his feathers<WH084>, and under his wings<WH03671> shalt thou trust<WH02620><WTH8799>: his truth<WH0571> <FI>shall be thy<Fi> shield<WH06793> and buckler<WH05507>.
Thou shalt not be afraid<WH03372><WTH8799> for the terror<WH06343> by night<WH03915>; <FI>nor<Fi> for the arrow<WH02671> <FI>that<Fi> flieth<WH05774><WTH8799> by day<WH03119>;

<FI> Nor<Fi> for the pestilence<WH01698> <FI>that<Fi> walketh<WH01980><WTH8799> in darkness<WH0652>; <FI>nor<Fi> for the destruction<WH06986> <FI>that<Fi> wasteth<WH07736><WTH8799> at noonday<WH06672>.
A thousand<WH0505> shall fall<WH05307><WTH8799> at thy side<WH06654>, and ten thousand<WH07233> at thy right hand<WH03225>; <FI>but<Fi> it shall not come nigh<WH05066><WTH8799> thee.
Only with thine eyes<WH05869> shalt thou behold<WH05027><WTH8686> and see<WH07200><WTH8799> the reward<WH08011> of the wicked<WH07563>.<CM>
Because thou hast made<WH07760><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, <FI>which is<Fi> my refuge<WH04268>, <FI>even<Fi> the most High<WH05945>, thy habitation<WH04583>;
There shall no evil<WH07451> befall<WH0579><WTH8792> thee, neither shall any plague<WH05061> come nigh<WH07126><WTH8799> thy dwelling<WH0168>.
For he shall give his angels<WH04397> charge<WH06680><WTH8762> over thee, to keep<WH08104><WTH8800> thee in all thy ways<WH01870>.
They shall bear thee up<WH05375><WTH8799> in <FI>their<Fi> hands<WH03709>, lest thou dash<WH05062><WTH8799> thy foot<WH07272> against a stone<WH068>.
Thou shalt tread<WH01869><WTH8799> upon the lion<WH07826> and adder<WH06620>: the young lion<WH03715> and the dragon<WH08577> shalt thou trample under feet<WH07429><WTH8799>. <RF>adder: or, asp<Rf>

Because he hath set his love<WH02836><WTH8804> upon me, therefore will I deliver<WH06403><WTH8762> him: I will set him on high<WH07682><WTH8762>, because he hath known<WH03045><WTH8804> my name<WH08034>.

He shall call<WH07121><WTH8799> upon me, and I will answer<WH06030><WTH8799> him: I <FI>will be<Fi> with him in trouble<WH06869>; I will deliver<WH02502><WTH8762> him, and honour<WH03513><WTH8762> him.
With long<WH0753> life<WH03117> will I satisfy<WH07646><WTH8686> him, and shew<WH07200><WTH8686> him my salvation<WH03444>. <RF>long...: Heb. length of days<Rf><CM>
